content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant Vacancy 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant: Postgraduate degree/MBA from a reputed institute or university (regular mode) with a minimum of 60% marks. Senior Research Assistant requires a minimum of two years of experience.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs. 40,000 - 50,000 consolidated per month plus HRA

content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Lucknow to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant positions is 04 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant in the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree or MBA from a reputed institute or university in a regular mode with a minimum of 60% marks. For the Senior Research Assistant role, a minimum of two years of relevant experience is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 50,000 per month, along with House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve two main stages: scrutiny of applications received and an online interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 226013.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for contractual positions at the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted online through the official website of IIM Lucknow or via the direct application link provided in the important links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the notification date for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for this recruitment was released on 22 September 2026.
